This looks like the same problem as #2890: with `no_wrap=True`, a column's content can squash the other columns below their minimum width, which is what happens to Name, Age and Country in your second example. Please follow the discussion there.

On the first try, `no_wrap=True` is what makes `overflow` apply. Without it, the text wraps, as described in the [table docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst).
